senses.gloss:
Dīrghatamas
(‘[One who was in] darkness for a long time’)
------------------------------------------
The वेदस् are considered as the basic scriptures of हिन्दुइस्म्. The Ṛgveda, the oldest literature of the world, comprises a large number of hymns which were revealed to a galaxy of sages called ṛṣis. A ṛṣi is a person of knowledge and wisdom based on intuitive experience.
Dīrghatamas is one such ṛṣi to whom a number of Ṛgvedic sūktas or hymns are attributed. The sūktas are: 1.140 to 164. Since he was born blind he was named ‘Dīrghatamas’. However he regained his sight by pleasing अग्नि through his hymns.
